about_the_game:
The world of dotAGE gets bigger! Folkways adds a lot of new content to unlock to the quirky strategy game with new mechanics!

Pipfolks Approach the Village!


We thought we were alone in this world... but I just remembered that different Pipfolks lived in these lands! Were they friend or foe? We will find out!

Meet the various Pipfolks that live at the outskirts of the village, try to get them to join your village and start populating it with their kin, or keep them at bay by making sure you do not anger them with your actions.
Pipfolks bring with them unique bonuses, special food and promotion requirements, dedicated events, and dedicated buildings for dwelling and for production.

From the mysterious Fishpips, to the industrious Dwarves, to the unreliable Cats and more, meet the various folks that make up the inhabitants of this strange world!

Keep Pips in check!


With new events that can make your Pips even more problemtic, Folkways also introduces some handy means to help you getting rid of Pips either temporarly, with cages and prisons, or even permanently (for a price...)

I seem to remember that we even had some... unorthodox ways to do so.

Three New Elders!


Alongside hundreds of new events and resources, three new Elders join the world of dotAGE, with their unique gameplay!

Play as Trisavolo, the Elder King of the Dwarves that live on the mountainous plateau, or help Dad build an autonomous village with the help of its Pipbots, and complete the story of Ronomy with its all-cat village!

Many more options for your villages!


This is not all! Folkways also introduces new VIPs, new terrains, many new boons, new resources and hundreds of new buildings and events. The goal is to introduce more variety to all your village, making your runs even more different!
